annotation.evidence_span: Automated clients MAY provide a configuration setting that disables this check, but MUST provide a setting which enables it.
annotation.interpretation_a: The client must provide at least one configuration setting that enables the check; it may optionally provide a separate setting that disables the check. The enabling setting could be the same as the disabling setting (e.g., a boolean toggle).
annotation.interpretation_b: The client must provide two distinct configuration settings: one that enables the check and another that disables it. The enabling setting cannot be the same as the disabling setting.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the enabling setting must be distinct from the disabling setting, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
